feature.description: The name of the frontend feature project.
feature.x-prompt: For which feature of the frontend should the microservice be created?

sentry.description: Whether this service should use Sentry for error tracking.

skipFormat.description: Whether to skip formatting files with Prettier after generation.

swagger.description: Whether this service should support Swagger/OpenAPI documentation generation.
swagger.x-prompt: Should this service support open-api config generation?

swaggerLive.description: Whether this service should start a live Swagger server in development mode.

generateMain.description: Whether to generate the 'main.ts' entry point file.

healthIndicator.description: Whether this service should include a health indicator endpoint.
healthIndicator.x-prompt: Should this service have a health indicator endpoint?

healthIndicatorList.description: A list of specific health indicators to include.

validator.description: Whether this service should use the NestJS 'ValidationPipe'.
validator.x-prompt: Should this service use the ValidationPipe?

platform.description: The underlying HTTP server platform to use.

port.description: The default port number for the microservice server.

sentryDsn.description: The default Sentry DSN for error reporting.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files during generation.

jwt.description: Whether the application should use JWT authentication.

openApi.description: Whether the application should use an OpenAPI client.
openApi.x-prompt: Should this service use an open api client?

apiConfigurationFile.description: The path to the API configuration file.

standalone.description: Whether the NestJS service should be a standalone application (not part of a larger monorepo structure).
